description: Local measurements, calibrated recommendation, Phase-1 report, design.md update and the full local suite (R3.3 hold-out, R3.5, R3.6/R3.7, R6, AC1, AC7-AC9, AC12; design sections 3.6, 4.3, 4.4, 5.6, 10). Plan items 18-21. Depends on FEAT-001..003.
steps: Plan item 18: on the GTX 1080 (TF_CUDNN_USE_AUTOTUNE=0, TF_CUDNN_WORKSPACE_LIMIT_IN_MB=512, --gpu-memory-limit-mb 6000, never higher) run the three hold-out invocations of design 5.6 (level 4 narrow N 2,3,4; level 4 default N 2; level 2 tiny --cascade true N 2 with T 7 if it fits else T 3, recorded) over --gradient-checkpointing full --amp false,true --lean-sampler false,true --lean-losses false,true --split-group-conv false,true --warmup-steps 1 --steps 3, plus the 8-record T6/T7 invocation of design 3.6, all into .agents/tasks/milestone-9/memory_holdout.json. Transcribe the four gated knob combinations (full; full+L; full+L+LL; full+all three; fp32 and AMP) into models/memory_calibration.json with status 'holdout' (others kept as information). If any ok hold-out point is outside +-20% or a hold-out OOM is predicted feasible: correct that knob's inventory in models/memory_model.py (never widen the gate) and document the correction. Re-run python scripts/memory_model.py fit (regenerates models/memory_coefficients.json) and tests.test_memory_model with the hold-out gate active.

Plan item 19: python -m tests.test_integration_steps --max-v 8 --out .agents/tasks/milestone-9/integration_steps.json (rerun with a larger --max-v only if justified per design 3.6; the m8 diag_u_res_max_vox max comes from the cluster job and is pending); python scripts/memory_model.py grid --out .agents/tasks/milestone-9/grid.json; python scripts/memory_model.py recommend --t6-verdict .agents/tasks/milestone-9/integration_steps.json --out .agents/tasks/milestone-9/recommendation.json --print-env. If the recommended widths/knobs differ from f0d1 + lean sampler + split, update WIDTHS/KNOBS defaults in slurm/m9_memory.sh to the printed env and keep tests/test_slurm_scripts.py passing. If recommend exits 3 (R3.7) or 4: STOP and call send_message severity 'warning' with the verdict for Jay; never choose N < 4 silently. Local outputs never go to the repo's scratch/ (not git-ignored).

Plan item 20: write .agents/tasks/milestone-9/report.md with every R6.1 item: R1 breakdown (level-2 inventory/phases, cross-check, level-1 scaling, largest tensors) with measured/fitted deltas; per-tensor-limit result (graph-mode output; run mode pending m9 job step 0a); knobs + verification numbers (checkpointing tests, lean-sampler graph-mode A/B/C numbers incl. the _DY_DEP-off case B, chain vs while_loop form used, split/lean-loss tolerances measured); memory-model accuracy table (R3.3) with leave-one-mode-out, hold-out table, warmup_excess_gib and fitted coefficients (flag any at a bound); level-1 grid summary, per-N tables (timed rule and both bounds, the forward one named 'order-independent estimate (one overlapping sampler forward)'), recommendation with all R3.6 fields (level-1 deform/linear peaks, A100 verdicts incl. fwd-bound fields, levels 4/2 peaks, step times labelled +-50%, long-run wall time); T6 vs T7 numbers and verdict; tooling summary and the exact m9 command for Jay ('DO NOT submit without Jay's approval': mkdir -p .../GroupwiseReg/logs then sbatch --job-name=m9mem --time=10:00:00 --mem=64G slurm/m9_memory.sh, RTX 8000, 3 CPUs, 64G, 10 h); R5 pointers to design section 6; added suite time (N3); requirements correction F16 (level-4/GTX points Dice only); plan NITs N1-N4 wording (int64 rationale + 'int32 indices pinned to the GPU' remedy); the open decision for Jay (--n-target 4 vs N >= 5 via no margin / forward corner sequencing). Update .agents/tasks/network-design/design.md sections 4.5, 4.6, 9, 11 with the implemented/measured outcomes and bump the version to v3.14 (status line).

Plan item 21: run the full suite in the background with a generous timeout (>= 4 h): wsl -d Ubuntu bash /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad/tests/run_tests_wsl.sh ; expect stage 1 OK and stage 2 OK with 381 + new tests and 4 + new GPU/DALI skips, both goldens printing max |diff| 0. Record counts, wall time and added time vs ~3 h in the report. Clean up: delete .agents/tmp scripts, __pycache__, any temp run dirs and anything written to the repo's scratch/; keep the JSON outputs in .agents/tasks/milestone-9/. Check git status shows only intended files.
